data_source: Yahoo Finance adjusted daily prices; European listing symbols; not official issuer NAV data

methodology.defensive_split: 24% XEON.DE EUR overnight-rate proxy + 16% SGLD.MI gold ETC
methodology.ranking: 68-session return / annualized volatility squared; invest in a regional ETF only when both 68-session and 12-month momentum are positive; otherwise redirect that 15% sleeve to XEON.DE; monthly rebalance
methodology.fallback_policy: Dynamic equity exposure: each region without a positive-momentum candidate moves its 15% sleeve to XEON.DE; total cash-like allocation can therefore exceed 24% and total equity exposure can fall below 60%.
methodology.signal_rule: Signal at prior month-end close; hold selected assets over the following calendar month
methodology.warning: Independent European UCITS approximation, not official Logical Invest. Universe limited to mapped candidates with uneven coverage. XEON is cash-like; SGLD is an ETC, not a UCITS ETF. No fees, taxes, slippage, FX hedging or currency conversion. Benchmark VWCE.DE is a proxy.

current_composition.note: Segnale fissato all'ultima chiusura mensile completa. 15% per ciascuna delle quattro aree; 24% XEON e 16% SGLD, con eventuali sleeve azionarie senza momentum positivo trasferite a XEON. SGLD è un ETC, non un ETF UCITS.
